name: Kaynes Technology
title: Transcript of the Earnings call for the Quarter ended 30 September 2026

read.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR9,525 mn (flat-to-single-digit growth) as Smart Meter sales fell ~80%; EMS grew 34%, but OSAT/PCB guidance and metering cash target are unverified, with capex raised by INR221 cr.

capex.quote: between quarter one and quarter two, we added an incremental of INR221 crores to the capex

triggers.label: Capex raised INR221 cr in Q2
triggers.quote: we added an incremental of INR221 crores to the capex

triggers.label: Strategic inventory INR200-250 cr held
triggers.quote: we have strategically built an inventory of INR200 crores-INR250 crores during April, which is continued to be there in this quarter

triggers.label: Smart Meter revenue down ~80% in Q2
triggers.quote: The Smart Meter revenue declined by about 12% in Q1, and of course, 80% in Q2 FY27

triggers.label: Smart Meter receivables INR1,402 → INR1,091 cr
triggers.quote: The receivables from Smart Meter business went down compared to previous quarter at INR1,091 crores, compared to INR1,402 crores in last quarter

triggers.label: Growth target reiterated, timing pushed out
triggers.quote: It's not a denied, it's going to be delayed. Maybe couple of quarters we'll get delayed

guidance.quote: we are confident of growing the electronic business itself with more than 30% for FY27 as a whole
that will deliver the growth of double of market growth

guidance.value: below INR750 crore before further sales
guidance.quote: We wanted to bring in the total receivables to less than INR750 crores
Depending on the, from December, we will start easing out the inventory. That is going to come out INR250 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: even though our overall revenue is flat or about single-digit growth
we added an incremental of INR221 crores to the capex
We wanted to bring in the total receivables to less than INR750 crores

red_flags.label: Restatement under Ind AS 8; EoM on both reviews
red_flags.quote: Both the review reports, consolidation standalone, carry an emphasis of matter, drawing attention to the restatement

red_flags.label: Net working capital days up to 169 from 163
red_flags.quote: the net working capital on total is 169 days from the company compared to 163 days of last quarter

red_flags.label: Bank-funded receivables moved into borrowings
red_flags.quote: Currently, we have restated as a part of the borrowing

red_flags.label: Vishay investment as parent loan repayment; QIP ruled out 12 months
red_flags.quote: For the next one year, I can assure you, we will not go

evasions.topic: Vishay definitive terms and JV structure
evasions.quote: we have signed an initial agreement with them, and we have to wait for the definitive agreement to come

evasions.topic: Smart Meter FY27 revenue and margin
evasions.quote: The second half of the revenue is purely based on the amount of collection that we need to bring in
